deadline.value: The PhD application deadline is December 15, 2026, and all materials must arrive by then.

app_fee.value: The department page points to the Guarini fee page for fees; that page was not reachable.

fee_waiver.value: The department page points to the Guarini fee-waiver page; that page was not reachable.

gre_general.value: The GRE General exam is optional for the Mathematics PhD.
gre_general.quote: Both the GRE general exam and the GRE math subject exam are optional

gre_subject.value: The Mathematics GRE subject exam is optional; submitting it is encouraged if it helps the application.
gre_subject.quote: Both the GRE general exam and the GRE math subject exam are optional

toefl_min.value: The department asks for English test scores but gives no TOEFL minimum.

ielts_min.value: The department asks for English test scores but gives no IELTS minimum.

english_waiver.value: English tests are required for non-native speakers, but waived after four years of study and a bachelor's at a US college or university. No India rule is stated.
english_waiver.quote: Official English language proficiency test scores are required for students for whom English is not their first language | This requirement can be waived for students who study for four years at a US college or university and graduate with a bachelor's degree

supervisor.value: The department page does not say whether a supervisor's agreement is needed.

funding.value: Admitted PhD students are offered support for up to five years, provided they make satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: The PhD program in Mathematics is fully funded. | Students who are admitted to the PhD program are offered support through a Dartmouth Fellowship or other grant for up to five years

entry_route.value: The department page does not say whether a master's is needed.

notes: Mathematics PhD from the department page (last modified 2025-02-07). The Guarini program page was not reachable (502). No separate statistics or data science PhD is listed on this page; dissertation topics such as data science and machine learning are research areas only.
